candidates.change_summary: Require that only the deployer (msg.sender at construction) can withdraw by checking msg.sender == tx.origin instead of owner, changing who can call withdrawAll.
Remove the owner check so anyone can call withdrawAll, allowing transfers by any caller.
Invert the require condition so that only non-owners can call withdrawAll, preventing the owner from withdrawing via this function.
Change transfer target to msg.sender so withdrawn funds always go to the caller rather than the provided recipient address.
Guard with a require that the recipient equals owner, forcing funds to be sent only to the owner's address even if a different recipient is passed.
Add a condition that the contract balance must be nonzero before transfer, reverting otherwise, which changes observable revert behavior when balance is zero.
